text:
The Islanders captain is doing the hard version of the job. Bo Horvat plays 21:20 a night, and Evolving-Hockey had his competition in the 99th percentile last season: he sees the other team's best line most nights.

He has 18 points in 18 games (8 goals, 10 assists), and his goals are a touch behind his chances, 8 on 8.8 expected. New York takes 53.4% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, 5.8 points better than without him. His last ten games brought 9 points against an expected 10.6, so if anything he has been a little short.

Wins added is the one sore spot: by our count his goals have swung 0.85 wins against 1.32 expected from his chances. The night in San Jose summed it up, with Yaroslav Askarov robbing him in overtime of a game the Islanders went on to lose.

What to watch: Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking found 59% of his shots came off the rush. The first few seconds after New York wins the puck are when he is most dangerous. Our projection has him finishing with about 38 goals.
